_comment: This root vercel.json is intentionally minimal. The canonical Vercel configuration (build command, framework) lives in app/web/vercel.json. Set 'Root Directory' to 'app/web' in the Vercel project dashboard. No crons here: both cron jobs (streak-evaluator, reprocess-pending) are triggered externally via cron-job.org — see docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.
